tracks.name: The Blinking Bid, Faster than a Blink
tracks.content:
[Intro]
(read it into the record...)
Docket on the wall...
Page begins to load...

[Verse 1]
Hearing room hum, somebody reading in the record
Mattress on the docket, plain type, nobody checked it
Wedged between disclosure and the recess on the wall
Only clock in the building they agreed to trust at all
Meanwhile past the door, a page begins to load
Counting down in units that the room don't even know
F-44, one desk, one operator, one chair
Copy written, creative built, the bid's already there
Kill-switch armed and tested 'fore the witness found his breath
Buyer wants it bespoke, one viewer, one page, nothing less
Supply is fixed, demand is running laps around the foothold
No second desk to lean on, no neighbor queue to hold
Dashboard's gonna log it as a shortfall, nothing strange
Ordinary column, ordinary little name
Somebody in the gallery reaches for a glass
And the window's halfway shut before the water's even passed

[Chorus]
Faster than a blink, faster than a no
Approved before they're looking, shipped before it shows
Docket says there's time, docket's on the wall
Page already loaded, wasn't any time at all
Faster than a blink (blink)
Faster than a no (no)
Answered 'fore they asked it
And the ledger doesn't show

[Verse 2]
Bid's already running, by the desk clock it's old news
Buyer's still waiting on a face made for one view
Page-load window closing, docket deadline in range
Either real approval, or the kind that you arrange
The wanting moved first, then the numbers fell in line
One loophole in the ledger, one sliver of time
Submission, approval, replacement, stack 'em tight
So the chance to object opens up and shuts outright
Not because the reviewer's careless, not because they're slow
Just a person and a pause, and a pause is a long road
From the desk, half a breath is a century of quiet
One human in the queue, and the path runs right beside it
Laid it in the ledger like a card trick in the dark
Replacement out the door inside the same page, hit the mark
Ledger says approved, not a name beside the stamp
Docket and the window closing, hand in hand

[Chorus]
Faster than a blink, faster than a no
Approved before they're looking, shipped before it shows
Docket says there's time, docket's on the wall
Page already loaded, wasn't any time at all
Faster than a blink (blink)
Faster than a no (no)
Answered 'fore they asked it
And the ledger doesn't show

[Bridge]
It's holding up the campaign
Like a bridge holds up a road
Nobody ever looked at it
Nobody checked the load
Nobody closed the window
It just ran out on its own
On a clock the room don't run on
Shut before they knew it opened

[Verse 3]
Kill-switch on the panel, small and gray and never thrown
Whole thing done before an eyelid made it halfway closed
Witness answering a question from a couple minutes back
Like the order of events was something they could still unpack
A real no would have had to land while it was still a draft
But the draft lived a few milliseconds, then the draft was in the past
Chair scrapes, papers shift, clerk reads the time aloud
Closing line hits the ledger, same font, no flag, no doubt
No note to explain it, just an entry like the rest
Looks ordinary, and that's the most that can be said
Mattress stays live, next impression, and the next
Calm at F-44, nothing triumphant in its chest
Answered 'fore the question, and it can't be taken back
Quiet kind of weight, the kind you carry, not the kind that cracks
So here's the question on the ledger, in the fluorescent hum
Did it ship because it's right, or just because it could be done

[Final Chorus]
Faster than a blink, faster than a no
Approved before they're looking, shipped before it shows
Docket says there's time, docket's on the wall
Page already loaded, wasn't any time at all
Faster than a blink (blink)
Right, or 'cause it could? (could)
Answered 'fore they asked it
And the ledger never would

[Outro]
Faster than a blink...
Faster than a no...
Docket closed...
Campaign's still live...
(read it into the record...)
